# HTML test suite

## Source

The suite contains 112 document-mode cases from html5lib/html5lib-tests `tree-construction/tests1.dat`, plus local cases for implied and foster-parented nodes, decoded entities, foreign namespaces, raw text, CDATA, discarded markup and tokenizer reconsumption.

## Version

html5lib is pinned at f994590f528ac8b6073665791ddb1ed85c66dfb2; the original data and license are retained in `../standard`. The independent-reference adapter case checks every reference entry, including invalid and root-level suite files. The shared conformance rail also checks diagnostic expectations and exact source reconstruction.
